This avoids them having to write accessor functions to reach inside PyCFunctionObject.

comment_data.body: Might be worth a comment that these macros are expected to be lvalues (thus the missing `Get` in their name).
Moving this field up changes much of the struct layout. I know that we only share our extension types per Cython version, but this seems something I wouldn't expect in a point release.
Reverted. I think it should be harmless but it also doesn't give us anything except one less pre-processor guard.

commit.message:
Make GraalPy use Limited API structure

This avoids them having to write accessor functions to reach
inside PyCFunctionObject.

Revert "Reorder for one less define"

This reverts commit 6008b9b4af9fc98f65bde625f458a5fec0bc683d.
